== 2008 MPC results and earlier standings ==

Added the Sunday consolation result from the post's numbered names: Pat Ziagos is 14th.<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18322#p254691 Sunday consolation results], Advocate, Players Committee Forums (8 January 2008).</ref>

The 2000 Coruscant result uses Decipher's exact designation, "co-champions", for John Lolli and Patrick Ziagos.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320id_/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher.</ref> The contemporary report also says, "Lolli won the final duel 2(+1) to win."<ref>[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-18-coruscant-regional-6-17-2000d900/ Coruscant Regional, 17 June 2000], Jonathan "jonnychu" Chu, DeckTech (18 June 2000).</ref> The table uses "Co-champion" for the official designation; the separate duel result is recorded here. The previous numeric label was "1st (tie)".

The 1999 Gauntlet source gives the standing after Game 1. Its fourth-place entry is now identified as that stage.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20001219125500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW30_2.html DecipherCon 1999 — The Gauntlet Dual Formats, Game 1], Decipher.</ref>
